notes_for_editor: Very thin. The Register has no description beyond 'No information known at this time.' and gives only the 1930s as the build period, so no build year is recorded. The firelookout.com and Forest Lookouts pages carry only location text and photo credits. Two web searches (Pryor lookout Crow Reservation history; Pryor lookout Crow Tribe BIA 1930s) found nothing about this tower; the results were about other lookouts and the Pryor Mountains. The record's access 'permission' and 'tribal' ownership are not stated in any page I read; the story advises checking with the Crow Tribe because the site lies on the reservation. Staffing and condition are unknown. The record's photo credits (Luke Channer, 2021 captions) were not found in the cached firelookout.com page, so no photos are proposed. Possible leads: Crow Agency BIA forestry or fire records, Custer Gallatin National Forest history, Montana SHPO.
